en: The postcard shows a vintage black-and-white photograph of a stone bridge over a river, with ornate features and a historic-looking structure in the center of the bridge. The bridge is surrounded by classic European buildings and has hills in the background. The style is typical of early 20th-century European postcard photography. The words 'Aue i. Erzgeb. König Albert-Brücke.' are printed at the top in red.
